metas.name: #Love
metas.description: The pragmatic creator of a dating app and her adventurous competitor test their theories about love in a 60-day challenge to find their ideal partner.

metas.name: Ab Hoga Hisaab
metas.description: Recently-deported NRI Bobby's life shatters when brother Bunty vanishes. His search exposes a human-trafficking ring masked as a Canada immigration network. With Inspector Dosanjh's help, Bobby battles corruption to save his brother.

metas.name: Adarsh Baal Vidyalaya
metas.description: A relaxed principal tries to reform a failing public school, triggering a messy transformation as misfit teachers work to repair the system one lesson at a time.

metas.name: Akka
metas.description: In a kingdom ruled by women, matriarch Bhavani faces her biggest threat in Rudra, a ruthless rebel eyeing her land and legacy.

metas.name: Amar Vishwas
metas.description: Amar Vishwas is a gripping legal drama about a fearless lawyer who believes that the law has value only when it protects the truly innocent. Shaped by a painful past, Amar has built his life around one unbreakable principal - if a person is innocent in reality, justice must be delivered, even if it means crossing boundries.

metas.name: Bandwaale
metas.description: Mariam, a young poetess, finds herself trapped in a sleepy town, where every young girl's future lies in wedlock. Mariam hopes to find her freedom against all odds, by uploading her poetry on the internet through an anonymous account.Along with her band of misfits - Robo and Psy, Mariam discovers the power of her poetry and her own voice.

metas.name: Brown
metas.description: Brown is a recovering alcoholic, who works for Kolkata Police and has to investigate the murder of a young woman from a well-known family.

metas.name: Chaar Yaar
metas.description: A story of four middle-class boys, their dreams, setbacks and friendship being their armour. A fateful decision leads them to take a step that changes the course of their lives trapping them between gangsters and cops. What once held them together slowly tears their bond. With their armour shattered, their enemies close in and fate serves up a bill for their crimes.

metas.name: Chiraiya
metas.description: Kamlesh's world as a devoted wife and daughter-in-law shatters when her new sister-in-law confides a disturbing secret about her wedding night, forcing Kamlesh to confront uncomfortable truths within her own family.

metas.name: Chumbak
metas.description: Five quirky families navigate life as neighbors in Chumbak Colony, where chaotic conflicts and hilarious antics turn each day into a new chapter.

metas.name: Clean Up Company
metas.description: 3 boys stumble upon an opportunity to make easy money by getting rid of dead bodies in a small city marred by gang wars. Things quickly take a turn for the worse and they end up neck deep in trouble fighting to survive.

metas.name: Daldal
metas.description: Haunted by the guilt of her past and dealing with the demons of her present, a newly-appointed DCP, Rita Ferreira, must embark on an investigation of a series of murders that puts her on a collision course with a cold-blooded serial killer.

metas.name: Exam
metas.description: A determined young woman with a mysterious past enters the dangerous world of the Regional Public Service Exam (RPSE) scam to expose a powerful paper-leak network. But as she digs deeper, she uncovers a corruption chain embedded deep within the education system-and must bring it down before it destroys the dreams of an entire generation.

metas.name: Eyes
metas.description: Tina Sebastian, a police officer investigates disturbing cases involving women. As the investigation progresses, mental health professionals join forces with the police to understand the psychology of stalkers, identify warning signs and prevent situations from escalating.

metas.name: Glory
metas.description: In a small-town boxing hub, two brothers investigate a shocking murder while navigating a troubled reunion with their father, a renowned coach.

metas.name: Hello Bachhon
metas.description: A physics teacher sets out to make quality education accessible to all students through online learning.

metas.name: Honeymoon Se Hatya
metas.description: A five-part true-crime docudrama uncovers real cases where wives kill their husbands. The series dives deep into how love, control, betrayal and hidden marital fractures can lead to fatal breakdowns

metas.name: Hunkkaar The Roar
metas.description: When a teenager accuses a revered cult leader of sexual assault, it sparks a national conflict. As the truth unravels, the line between faith and justice blurs.

metas.name: Isakapatnam
metas.description: Set in the 1990s, in the ruthless port town of Isakapatnam, three forces collide—a woman driven by justice, a henchman torn by loyalty, and a common man hungry for revenge—each closing in on the empire built by the port’s most powerful man, Naidu.

metas.name: Jazz City
metas.description: Set in 1971 Calcutta, a jazz club becomes the backdrop for a revolutionary awakening as music intertwines with language, identity and the birth of a nation during a pivotal historical moment.

metas.name: Kaakee Circus
metas.description: A small town in Tamil Nadu wakes up to chaos when a temple donation box is stolen from the sub-jail. Soon, the investigation led by two eccentric policemen unravels secrets more than they can handle.

metas.name: Kaptaan
metas.description: SSP Samardeep, a feared encounter specialist, hides a broken past behind his ruthless image. Years ago, in his pursuit of revenge, he abandoned his informant DK’s brothers. Now In Jwalabad, as Munna, Tinnu, and Shaheen battle for a ₹180-crore tender, Samar joins forces with the ruthless Kabir—only to discover he is one of those lost children, forcing him to face his past.

metas.name: Kasargod Embassy
metas.description: Azi and Chemmu, cousins trapped in poverty in late 2000s Kasaragod, work for their cunning uncle Razak Mama, whose stationery shop hides a forgery racket.

metas.name: Lingam
metas.description: Framed for a crime he didn't commit, a kabaddi hero gets pushed into a world he never wanted and ultimately becomes a feared name.

metas.name: Love Always
metas.description: A heartfelt tale of rediscovery about life and an unexpected second chance at love.

metas.name: Lukkhe
metas.description: A young sportsman infiltrates the wild and dangerous world of Punjab's rap music to investigate a drug syndicate, only to find himself torn between love, family, guilt and brotherhood.

metas.name: Made In India A Titan Story
metas.description: In a market ruled by smuggling and foreign brands, a determined Indian man Xerxes Desai, with the help of his team, dares to build a world-class watch from scratch. Battling rejection, failure, and global humiliation, they transform Titan into a symbol of national pride and innovation.

metas.name: Margao Files The Unsolved Case
metas.description: Doctors overrule foul play on the mysterious death of Richard White, patriarch of Margao's wealthy family. Yet Richard's family harbors deep suspicions after his will reveals unsettling secrets.

metas.name: Matargashti
metas.description: Dhara's plan to explore her sexuality puts her at odds with her horrified father, who becomes determined to sabotage her love life.

metas.name: Matka King
metas.description: In this fictional tale set in 1960s Mumbai, an enterprising cotton trader who craves legitimacy and respect, starts a new gambling game dubbed ‘Matka’, that takes the city by storm and democratizes a terrain previously reserved for the rich and elite.

metas.name: Musafir Cafe
metas.description: Chander feels an undeniable connection with Sudha. Years later, he builds a new life in the hills with Preeti, but memories of the past linger.

metas.name: Muthassi
metas.description: In a remote village haunted by ancient secrets, a mother's love is put to the ultimate test when her son becomes entangled in a terrifying supernatural curse.

metas.name: Muthu Alias Kaattaan
metas.description: A story of an man who becomes a legend, a Monster, and a Miracle, depending on the Storyteller.

metas.name: Operation Safed Sagar
metas.description: As the Kargil War erupts between India and Pakistan, the Golden Arrows squadron of the Air Force takes flight on a dangerous mission behind enemy lines.

metas.name: Pritam and Pedro
metas.description: The dynamic between the two contrasting personalities, a seasoned cop who prefers old-school methods and a tech-savvy cop who relies on modern technology for investigations, as they navigate their partnership in solving crimes.

metas.name: Psycho Saiyaan
metas.description: Kartik Pandey, a poetic student in Ujjain, becomes obsessed with Charu, convinced she is his destiny. When she disappears, he learns she’s trapped by ruthless gangster-politician Huntry Chauhan. Infiltrating Huntry’s haveli, Kartik enters a violent world of manipulation where love turns toxic, obsession deepens, and sanity blurs into madness.

metas.name: Raakh
metas.description: When two teenagers vanish, a close-knit family is shattered and the city is left on edge. Determined to uncover the truth, a relentless officer leads a nationwide manhunt that pulls him deep into a world of violence and human depravity.

metas.name: Sangamarmar
metas.description: Amrita sacrifices her budding romance with Aditya to fulfill family responsibilities. Their tender love endures through years of separation, becoming a poignant tale of sacrifice, silent strength, and unchanging devotion.

metas.name: Sankalp
metas.description: SANKALP is a premium Indian socio-political drama that explores how power is manufactured not through elections, but through mentorship and institutional control. Inspired by the ancient Chanakya–Chandragupta chronicles, the series reimagines political strategy for modern India, where classrooms replace battlefields and bureaucrats replace soldiers.

metas.name: Satrangi Badle Ka Khe
metas.description: Witness the tale of Bablu, who is forced into Launda Naach, just like his murdered father. To what lengths will he go to avenge the wrongs that the powerful Singhs have bestowed on him and his family?

metas.name: Shaque Trust No One
metas.description: A mother receives yearly photos of her missing child. After nine years of searching, she discovers the truth about the abduction lies not far away, but hidden among her closest circle.

metas.name: Space Gen Chandrayaan
metas.description: Indian space engineers face mounting pressure to redeem themselves following the Chandrayaan 2 lunar mission's unexpected outcome.

metas.name: Student of the Year 3
metas.description: Folder: Hindi

metas.name: Super Subbu
metas.description: An unlucky teacher is assigned to teach sex ed in a hostile village. Can he balance this secret while chasing his dreams and saving his relationship?

metas.name: Taskaree The Smugglers Web
metas.description: A dedicated customs officer and his team take on a notorious smuggler leading a powerful syndicate, but unexpected obstacles threaten their mission.

metas.name: The Pyramid Scheme
metas.description: Follows the story of Goldy, an ambitious but impatient young man, whose quest to get rich through a pyramid marketing business spirals into a rollercoaster of chaos - risking not just his future, but also the love and trust of his close-knit joint family.

metas.name: The Revolutionaries
metas.description: The Revolutionaries narrates the inspiring tale of brave young Indian freedom fighters who fought for ending British Raj with their unwavering spirit and ideology.

metas.name: Vimal Khanna
metas.description: An accountant accused of killing his brother flees, assumes the identity Vimal Khanna, and faces blackmail while seeking his vanished wife. Survival and accidental heroism drive noir-style rescues and moral choices.

metas.name: Waiting Hai
metas.description: Sugam joins the RPF and investigates a Tatkal scam. Hamza and Mama turn booking software into a business, facing rivalry and betrayal. Sugam arrests the agents and tracks Hamza, ending the scam before his escape to Dubai.

metas.name: 13th Some Lessons Arent Taught In Classrooms
metas.description: 13th tells the story of Ritesh, a successful venture capitalist who reunites with his maverick IIT-JEE mentor, Mohit Tyagi Sir, to help scale his visionary educational institute. The series unfolds against the backdrop of India's most gruelling academic competition and a startup culture fixated on valuations. At its heart, 13th is a deeply nostalgic, human story of a master and his pupil-bound by ambition, respect, and the lessons that shape a lifetime.

metas.name: Agra Affair
metas.description: Akash struggles to save his family's crumbling hotel while pursuing his dream restaurant. He falls for tour guide Tanvi, but their romance faces hurdles. Akash's path intertwines with Megha's, leading to a poignant story of love, ambition.

metas.name: Andhera
metas.description: In this visceral tale of urban horror, a fearless cop and a haunted medical student must take on this living darkness to avert impending doom.

metas.name: Arabia Kadali
metas.description: A fictional suspense drama series that revolves around a group of fishermen from rival villages who inadvertently trespass into international waters and find themselves imprisoned in a foreign jail.

metas.name: Badaa Naam Karenge
metas.description: Folder: Hindi

metas.name: Bakaiti 2025
metas.description: Set in old Ghaziabad, this heartwarming series follows the Kataria family grappling with a financial crunch. When Naina is forced to share her room with her younger brother Bharat, sibling tensions rise.

metas.name: Bhay The Gaurav Tiwari Mystery
metas.description: Folder: Hindi

metas.name: Bindiya Ke Bahubali
metas.description: With humour, absurdity and family cat and mouse at its center, this is a tale of family gangsters in a fictitious madhouse city, Bindiya. As the current Don is put behind bars, the gangster family's alliances shift, new love, friendships, and betrayals explode until Bindiya becomes a full-blown circus-where love is a deal, power is personal, and every one has a card and blood on their hands.

metas.name: Black Warrant
metas.description: When an upright officer accepts a job at Tihar Jail, he vows to make amends after witnessing cold-blooded corruption within its walls.

metas.name: Black White & Gray Love Kills
metas.description: Truth is never black or white. A high-profile case of serial killings takes an unexpected turn when forbidden love and deception come into play. In a world where love can kill, uncovering the truth is more dangerous than ever.

metas.name: Chhal Kapat The Deception
metas.description: When a famous influencer is found dead during a destination wedding in a remote village, a cynical yet brilliant cop unearths dark secrets, hidden betrayals, and shocking truths, as every guest becomes a suspect in a twisted web of love.

metas.name: Chidiya Udd
metas.description: Inspired by real incidents and based on a book Cages by Abid Surti - Chidiya Udd is a story of struggle and fighting all odds told from the eyes of the protagonist, a 20-year-old Seher, who hails from Rajasthan. We follow her journey to Mumbai with a dream of making it in the big city. Set against the backdrop of gang wars and a dark underbelly of crime, will Seher survive Bombay?

metas.name: CO ED
metas.description: Twins Shikha and Nikhil couldn't be more different. But when their all-boys and all-girls schools suddenly go co-ed, the chaos of teenagehood hits them head-on. Now, both must confront new feelings, friendships, and the messy business of growing up together.

metas.name: Crime Beat
metas.description: Small-town crime journalist Abhishek finds his life and career affected by a fugitive gangster. As he gets trapped in a web of lies and motives, what price will he pay- to become a renowned reporter?

metas.name: Crime Patrol 26 Jurm 26 Cases
metas.description: From disturbing murder cases to gripping investigations, follow police officers as they delve into the most violent crimes that plague society.

metas.name: Criminal Justice A Family Matter
metas.description: Attorney Madhav Mishra represents Raj Nagpal, discovered with murdered nurse Roshni Saluja after his child's party. As the trial unfolds, hidden facts emerge, questioning identities.

metas.name: Dabba Cartel
metas.description: When an investigation into a pharma company hits close to home, five women launch a tiffin service with a secret ingredient.

metas.name: Devika And Danny
metas.description: Devika, a compassionate and grounded music teacher living a seemingly ordinary life, is engaged to an insecured and possessive Jaggu. Meanwhile, she bumps into a stranger Danny and his arrival begins to shift Devika's world, leading her down an unforeseen path of self-discovery and unexpected connections.

metas.name: Do You Wanna Partner
metas.description: Best friends Shikha and Anahita turn entrepreneurs with an exciting craft beer brand, Jugaaro, to stand out in the crowded NCR beer market. However, they face gender discrimination every step of the way. To fight for an equal place in this male dominated sector, they decide to invent a fictitious male partner to help smooth their way. Invariably, things don’t go exactly as planned. What follows are their collective adventures & misadventures in trying to build a successful start-up amidst the current boom, as the bunch of misfits band together and become a family.

metas.name: Dupahiya 2025
metas.description: Dhadakpur, the Belgium of Bihar, is on the cusp of celebrating 25 years of being crime free. But chaos strikes when a never-seen-before motorbike, that was purchased as a wedding gift gets stolen 7 days before the ceremony! The journey taken by the bride's family and ex-lover to find the Dupahiya forms the heart of this comedy, which explores the hopes and aspirations of simple people.

metas.name: Ek Farzi Love Story
metas.description: Two contrasting worlds collide when an aspiring content creator Kritika and social media-averse CA, Manav find themselves stuck together thanks to an unexpected encounter. A viral video of their unique banter becomes the foundation of an unconventional partnership, where they have nothing in common, common except the fact that they agree to disagree on everything. As they become unlikely best friends offline, they pretend to be a fake couple online for the sake of their followers, who perceive them as a couple and as their fandom explodes they become an internet sensation.

metas.name: First Copy
metas.description: In the heart of Mumbai during the 1990s, 'Arif,' a notorious and desperately romantic figure, rises to infamy as the kingpin of film piracy. As he weaves an intricate web of distribution, his audacious exploits attract the attention of law enforcement, Bollywood celebrities, and the criminal underworld, leading to a thrilling cat-and-mouse chase.

metas.name: Gram Chikitsalay
metas.description: The young, idealistic and brilliant Dr. Prabhat, takes charge of a neglected Primary Health Centre in a North India Village hoping to bring about much needed changes only to realise it is he who will have do change before anything else.

metas.name: Griha Laxmi
metas.description: Laxmi, a housewife in Betalgadh, stumbles upon weed during a police chase and starts selling it to save her family, navigating danger, secrets, and morality to become Betalgadh's queen of weed.

metas.name: Hai Junoon
metas.description: Talent vs Ambition. Music vs Dance. At Anderson College, rivalries explode in a cut-throat battle for the GOATs Trophy. Who will rise? Who will break?

metas.name: Janaawar The Beast Within
metas.description: As SI Hemant Kumar explores a missing person's case in the jungle town of Chhattisgarh, he is determined to solve it. Trouble follows when that leads to a string of bodies and a likely serial killer.

metas.name: Kanneda
metas.description: Against the backdrop of 1990s Toronto, a Punjabi singer's journey from street performer to rising star leads him into dangerous territory.

metas.name: Khakee The Bengal Chapter
metas.description: When upright cop Arjun Maitra takes on Kolkata's feared don Bagha and his henchmen, he must battle a broken system and navigate bloody gang wars.

metas.name: Khauf 2025
metas.description: Madhu moves into a hostel in Delhi to start afresh, but her room hides a sinister presence that begins to get stronger each day, alarming the other women on her floor. They know what the room hides and desperately want her gone before it is too late for them all.

metas.name: Kill Dill The Heartbreak Club
metas.description: Kisha's search for her missing sister leads her to The Heartbreak Club, a shadowy campus organization. With help from charming captain Tavish, she delves deeper into a web of dangerous secrets.

metas.name: Knock Knock Kaun Hai
metas.description: Tanya makes a death wish on a dare app sets off a dangerous game of blackmail and violence. As her loved ones become targets, she must race against time to unmask the 'Knock Knock' Killer before it's too late.

metas.name: Kobali
metas.description: Two families become entangled in revenge, greed, and payback. Rising tensions unearth buried secrets that impact multiple lives.

metas.name: Kurukshetra
metas.description: One war, 18 days, 18 perspectives. Follow two families as they engage in an expansive and legendary clash for power, honor and revenge.

metas.name: Kuttram Purindhavan The Guilty One
metas.description: Folder: Hindi

metas.name: Lafangey 2025
metas.description: Folder: Hindi

metas.name: Lakadbaggey
metas.description: An intense and thrilling story of four friends who uncover a dangerous exam paper leak racket, exposing a nexus of corruption that exploits students dreams.

metas.name: Lets Play Blind Har Chaal Ek Dhokha
metas.description: Let's Play Blind is set in the flashy and risky world of gambling. Three rich friends-Mohini, Neeta and Shanaya-play not just for money but for power and control. Things change when Mohak and Kavya join the game with a hidden plan.

metas.name: Love Under Construction
metas.description: Vinod is ready to build his dream house. But is he ready to face the hurdles in his path?

metas.name: Mandala Murders
metas.description: When a series of ritualistic murders shakes a small town, a detective and an ex-cop must investigate a mystery with deep ties to their pasts.

metas.name: Mayasabha
metas.description: Mayasabha is a period political drama set in Mid 70s Andhra Pradesh. Krishnama Naidu, an idealistic student leader and a charismatic MS Rami Reddy wade into the world of Andhra politics. As they turn thick friends, they strive to use politics as a means to achieve public good. But caste fault lines erupt, loyalties are tested and their bond is pushed to the brink. Will their friendship sustain the brutal ascent of power where there is place for only one at the summit?

metas.name: Mistry
metas.description: Armaan Mistry is a brilliant ex-cop, who can solve the toughest of cases with no qualms. Just one problem: he has extreme OCD.

metas.name: Mitti Ek Nayi Pehchaan
metas.description: "Mitti – Ek Nayi Pehchaan" follows Raghav Sharma’s return to Dol Chhapra, his ancestral village, to fulfill his late grandfather’s vision of modern farming. Leaving behind his life as a creative director in advertising, Raghav confronts village rivalries and emotional ties as he embarks on a profound journey of transformation—from urban professional to progressive farmer, rediscovering identity, purpose, and belonging.

metas.name: Mrs Deshpande
metas.description: Behind a mask of beauty lies a darkness she's ready to unleash.

metas.name: Oops Ab Kya
metas.description: An accident during a medical check-up changes Roohi's life completely, she must face whatever fate has in store for her.

metas.name: Perfect Family
metas.description: A Punjabi family appears happy but deals with hidden issues, attending therapy together to address mental health and family bonds while fighting cultural stigma.

metas.name: Power of Paanch
metas.description: Bela's journey to Panchgiri unveils family secrets, mystical powers, and a battle against dark forces with friends who control wind, fire, water and earth.

metas.name: Pyaar Testing
metas.description: Dhruv and Amrita, potential marriage partners, decided to live together before the wedding to test their compatibility. As they spend time together, the question arises that whether they develop romantic feelings between them.

metas.name: Pyar Ka Professor
metas.description: A seduction coach with a body count of 99 women decides to pursue the beautiful wife of a menacing politician for his 100th; only to realize that his 5 step 'Pyar Ka Professor' plan leads him to discover the one thing he's always run away from, love.

metas.name: Rangeen 2025
metas.description: After discovering his wife's betrayal, a straight-laced husband dives into the hidden world of paid intimacy as a twisted act of revenge. Clueless and out of his depth, he stumbles through misadventures that mix awkward hilarity with raw self-discovery - forcing him to question his notions of love, manhood, and morality.

metas.name: Real Kashmir Football Club
metas.description: Inspired by the true story of a Kashmiri Hindu Pandit and a Kashmiri Muslim responsible for the formation of the Real Kashmir Football Club, the first ever club from Jammu and Kashmir to compete in any top-flight football league in India.

metas.name: Regai
metas.description: SI Vetri investigates a medical team that is trying to cover up deaths of clinical trial participants by staging them as accidents. Can Vetri put an end to this sinister plot before it's too late?
